units.source_text: "南泉斩猫"也见于碧岩录里的第63则《南泉斩猫》和第64则《赵州头戴草鞋》两则，

en.t: "Nanquan Cuts the Cat" also appears in two cases in the Blue Cliff Record: case 63, "Nanquan Cuts the Cat," and case 64, "Zhaozhou Wears His Straw Sandals on His Head,"

units.source_text: 这是自古以来公认难解的参禅课题。

en.t: and since ancient times it has been acknowledged as a difficult Zen koan to interpret.
